ancestry.runic_roots.bestial.backstory: Folk of ancient beast bloodlines, gifted with sharp senses, agility, and predatory instinct.
ancestry.runic_roots.draconic.backstory: Heirs of dragonkind: elemental drakes, grounded scale-bearers and lean gliders, united by draconic presence and demanding blood.
ancestry.runic_roots.dwarf.backstory: Stout folk of stone and forge: armored, enduring, and unmatched below the earth, but slow and magic-poor.
ancestry.runic_roots.elf.backstory: Ancient and graceful, the elves command arcane tradition and keen senses at the cost of fragile bodies.
ancestry.runic_roots.fae.backstory: Small fae of wild magic and illusion: swift, magical, and often winged, but delicate of body.
ancestry.runic_roots.fiend.backstory: Born of infernal blood, fiends carry fire in their veins and wrath in their temper. Water and the holy are their bane.
ancestry.runic_roots.revenant.backstory: Those who came back. Death did not finish them: the risen dead, the bound and the unquiet, ageless and barren, strong in the night and undone by the sun and the holy.
ancestry.runic_roots.skeletons.backstory: Bones that would not lie still. Old oaths hold them together; they remember their burial, and some still carry what they were buried with.
ancestry.runic_roots.wailers.backstory: Grief given a shape: pale shades that drift where their legs should be, keening a warning before the blow falls.
ancestry.runic_roots.wraiths.backstory: Shadow in a shroud: silent shades that drift rather than walk, cold-eyed and hungry for what the living still have.
ancestry.runic_roots.zombies.backstory: The plague raised them and stubbornness keeps them walking: slow, tireless, and very hard to put down.

gene.runic_roots.valen.build.desc: The shape of their body: how broad, how heavy-set.
gene.runic_roots.valen.fortitude.desc: +2 hearts, +2 armor, knockback resistance, +10% melee damage, and a sprinting shoulder-check that staggers the first foe you strike.
gene.runic_roots.valen.scales.desc: Face paint in red ochre and white clay, each its own design.
gene.runic_roots.valen.stalwart_not_swif: -8% movement speed and -8% attack speed. Heavy and deliberate.
gene.runic_roots.valen.unbreakable_stand: Plant yourself: Resistance III, Absorption II, and Slowness I for 6s. 60-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.ambience.des: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.complexion.d: The colour of this people's scales.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.dhampir_pall: The dhampir's pallor, over this people's own colour.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.eyes.desc: Draconic eyes, all iris and no whites.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.grounded.des: -1.5 hearts, +25% damage while wet, and weaker when shut away from the open sky.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.horns.desc: Horns or a spined crest; males grow them heavier.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.lightning_br: Loose a bolt of stormfire that stuns and dazzles. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.scales.desc: The pattern their scales grow in.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.stormscale_h: Immune to lightning, +2 armor, +15% speed, +10% attack speed, and gliding wings.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.thermal.desc: Charged and restless; warm, and warmer in a storm.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.vampire_pall: The vampire's pallor, over this people's own colour.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.deathwatch.desc: Poison immunity. Once per second, sense up to three hostile creatures below half health, within 8 blocks and sight, through small owner-only target wisps.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.fraying_spirit.d: -4 maximum HP and 15% more ordinary physical damage taken. Use cover and space during the cry's warning.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.keening_cry.desc: After a visible and audible 0.5s warning, cry into a 6-block cone with a 35-degree half-angle. Up to six threats in sight take 2 HP, Weakness I for 4s and moderate knockback. Move 30% slower during the warning. Bosses resist control; player control requires server permission and has half duration. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.tail.desc: Where legs would be, the shroud trails away to a wisp.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.thermal.desc: A spirit: the weather passes through them.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.translucence.des: Not wholly here: light passes through.
gene.runic_roots.wildfire_wyrm.wildfire_: A wind-driven lunge that sets alight everything it passes through, leaving flames where it started.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.complexion.de: The colour of this people's scales.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.dhampir_pallo: The dhampir's pallor, over this people's own colour.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.eyes.desc: Draconic eyes, all iris and no whites.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.galeforce_bre: Summon a roaring gale that launches foes skyward as you ride the updraft. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.horns.desc: Horns or a spined crest; males grow them heavier.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.scales.desc: The pattern their scales grow in.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.skylord.desc: The strongest wings of all, Slow Falling, no fall damage, and +15% speed. Born to soar.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.thermal.desc: Born to the high, thin air: wind-chill means little to them.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.untethered.de: -2 hearts; shut away underground you are slowed, weakened, and take more harm.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.vampire_pallo: The vampire's pallor, over this people's own colour.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.half_bound.desc: -2.5 hearts, weakened in direct sunlight, and +20% damage from holy magic.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.soul_touched.des: Night vision, no fall damage, and your strikes grow deadlier in the dark of night.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.spectral_phase.d: Turn incorporeal: Invisibility, Resistance, and drifting Speed while you drain a sliver of life from the souls around you. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.tail.desc: Where legs would be, shadow trails away to a wisp.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.thermal.desc: Shadow: the weather passes through them.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.translucence.des: Not wholly here: light passes through.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.complexion.de: The colour of this people's scales.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.dhampir_pallo: The dhampir's pallor, over this people's own colour.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.exposed_membr: -2 maximum HP and 15% more projectile damage taken. Cover your exposed membranes from arrows and magical projectiles.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.eyes.desc: Draconic eyes, all iris and no whites.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.horns.desc: Horns or a spined crest; males grow them heavier.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.lean_wings.de: Innate gliding wings, +1 armor and 25% less fall damage. No independent powered flap; use terrain and the occasional swoop.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.scales.desc: The pattern their scales grow in.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.thermal.desc: Lean and wiry; handles heat better than cold.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.vampire_pallo: The vampire's pallor, over this people's own colour.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.venom_swoop.d: Lunge up to 3 blocks from the ground or sweep up to 5 blocks while already gliding. The first legal collision takes 5 HP physical damage and Poison I for 3s. Walls and protected bodies stop you. No weapon damage, repeated contact hits or powered ascent. 35-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.airborne_essence: Glide on visible air-ribbon wings and take 50% less fall damage. Flap for +0.30 upward velocity every 2s; each flap costs one feather when enabled. Wind Wyrm remains the stronger powered flier.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.build.desc: The shape of their body: how broad, how heavy-set.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.crosswind.desc: Redirect yourself horizontally up to 5 blocks over 0.4s. Solid obstacles stop you. Crosswind deals no damage, grants no invulnerability, and cannot launch you upward. 30-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.dhampir_pallor.d: The dhampir's pallor, over this people's own colour.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.ears.desc: Fine fae ears, quick to show every mood.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.scales.desc: Ribbons of wind, or wisps of cloud.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.scattered_form.d: -4 maximum HP and 1.40 times knockback received. Avoid exposed melee and keep room to recover your direction.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.thermal.desc: Air spirits: wind and chill mean little to them.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.vampire_pallor.d: The vampire's pallor, over this people's own colour.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
gene.runic_roots.zombie.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.zombie.complexion.desc: The shade of their rotting skin.
+3 hearts, +1 armor, immune to Poison and Hunger, and hard to knock down.
gene.runic_roots.zombie.plague.desc: The marks of the plague that raised them.
gene.runic_roots.zombie.sunlight_decay.d: -10% speed and your flesh decays in direct sunlight; you heal slowly.
gene.runic_roots.zombie.thermal.desc: Cold flesh that rots faster in the heat.
gene.runic_roots.zombie.undying_hunger.d: Refuse to die: Resistance II, Regeneration, and Strength for 8s. 90-second cooldown.
heritage.runic_roots.blizzard_wyrm.backs: Frost on the wind, Blizzard Wyrms bring the white-out with them.
heritage.runic_roots.dust_drake.backstor: Earth carried on the wind, Dust Drakes wander the dry places.
heritage.runic_roots.geyser_drake.backst: Heat beneath the waves: Geyser Drakes are calm on the surface and boiling below.
heritage.runic_roots.magma_drake.backsto: Fire sunk into stone: Magma Drakes are slow to anger and slower to cool.
heritage.runic_roots.reef_drake.backstor: Stone shaped by the tide, Reef Drakes are as patient as the sea floor.
heritage.runic_roots.squall_serpen.backs: Storm over open water, Squall Serpens crackle when the waves rise.
heritage.runic_roots.steam_drake.backsto: Born where fire meets frost, Steam Drakes run hot and cold at once, wreathed in the vapour of a temper that never settles.
heritage.runic_roots.storm_wyrm.backstor: Lightning riding the gale, Storm Wyrms are never still for long.
heritage.runic_roots.tundra_drake.backst: Ice locked into earth, Tundra Drakes endure what would crack any other.
heritage.runic_roots.wildfire_wyrm.backs: Flame given wings of wind, Wildfire Wyrms spread wherever they go.
lineage.runic_roots.arachnid.backstory: Patient weavers born of silk and shadow who read the world through vibration; venomous, precise, oath-bound.
lineage.runic_roots.astral_elf.backstory: Star-minded wanderers who leave a thread behind each daring step. Their gift remembers a safe beginning, never an unknown destination.
lineage.runic_roots.auroran.backstory: A quiet sunrise lives in these mortal souls. Aurorans shelter their companions with brief, carefully shared light.
lineage.runic_roots.avian.backstory: Proud, sharp-eyed folk of skyborne blood; scouts and storm-watchers bound to wind and song.
lineage.runic_roots.blood_elf.backstory: Proud elves of crimson rites and bloodcraft; relentless survivors who pay power's price in blood.
lineage.runic_roots.bovine.backstory: Strong horned folk who stand together and commit with their whole weight. A Bovine's charge is a promise to follow one path to its end.
lineage.runic_roots.canine.backstory: Loyal, resilient folk of wolf and hound blood; pack-bound hunters and trackers.
lineage.runic_roots.celeron.backstory: Swift, witty wanderers of the messenger god's line; they prize speed, truth, and the open road.
lineage.runic_roots.changeling.backstory: Mysterious shapeshifters who wear faces like masks; spies and infiltrators free to define themselves beyond blood.
lineage.runic_roots.chelon.backstory: Shell-backed folk who know when to step out and when to endure. Their refuge is brief, deliberate, and carried upon their own shoulders.
lineage.runic_roots.colossan.backstory: Giant-descended mortals who measure strength in the weight of a single promise. Their blows arrive slowly, and leave a lasting impression.
lineage.runic_roots.crystal_one.backstor: Gem-attuned dwarves whose composure catches the sharp edge of sorcery. A single ringing answer matters more than a storm of reflections.
lineage.runic_roots.dark_elf.backstory: Secretive masters of shadow and intrigue from moonless caverns; assassins who answer betrayal without mercy.
lineage.runic_roots.deep_one.backstory: Ancient dwarves of the world's lowest halls where sunlight is legend; unmatched miners with darkvision and stubborn will.
lineage.runic_roots.demon.backstory: Fierce infernal beings of cursed realms; horned and burning-eyed masters of fire and forbidden power who seize fate by force.
lineage.runic_roots.dryad.backstory: Graceful forest-born fae bound to grove and root; gentle healers whose wrath is as old and unforgiving as the forest.
lineage.runic_roots.faerie.backstory: Small, magical fae of ancient glades and moonlit flowers; whimsical tricksters whose magic can bless, confuse, protect, or punish.
lineage.runic_roots.feline.backstory: Graceful, instinctive folk of catlike blood; agile night-stalkers whose elegance hides predatory confidence.
lineage.runic_roots.fire_drake.backstory: Drakes of ember and ash whose hearts burn like a forge; their breath is living flame and their scales drink the heat.
lineage.runic_roots.forge_one.backstory: Dwarves born to hammer and heat; master smiths whose work outlasts its maker, proven in fire.
lineage.runic_roots.frost_one.backstory: Hardy dwarves of glacial halls and bitter winds; cold-immune survivors whose hearts burn warm beneath frost.
lineage.runic_roots.grove_elf.backstory: Woodland travelers who learn the wind before drawing a bow. Stillness, a clear sightline, and one patient arrow are their chosen tools.
lineage.runic_roots.high_elf.backstory: Ancient, disciplined masters of arcane tradition; proud keepers of old magic.
lineage.runic_roots.ice_drake.backstory: Pale drakes of glacier and rime; their breath is a killing cold and their scales never thaw.
lineage.runic_roots.ice_elf.backstory: Cold, disciplined elves of glacial halls and northern lights; frost-mages and wardens, patient and steadfast.
lineage.runic_roots.iron_one.backstory: Stern, battle-hardened dwarves of fortress-holds; tough as forged plate, made to stand where others break.
lineage.runic_roots.kitsune.backstory: Clever fox-spirits of enchanted blood; illusionists and wandering sages whose charm and hidden fire grow with age.
lineage.runic_roots.magi.backstory: Humans birthed from raw magic — Primian descendants who survived lethal arcane overexposure; magic flows where blood should.
lineage.runic_roots.moon_elf.backstory: Graceful elves bound to moonlight and tides; seers and silvered spellcasters, gentle yet dangerous beneath the stars.
lineage.runic_roots.moss_one.backstory: Keepers of sheltered mushroom gardens, these dwarves carry the patience of deep roots. A small haven is their answer to a harsh world.
lineage.runic_roots.mountain_one.backsto: Stoneworkers who hear a measured rhythm in the mountains. Their craft is patient excavation, one honest block at a time.
lineage.runic_roots.nightborn.backstory: Nocturnal hunters with a brief and carefully bounded hunger. The living world still offers them ordinary food, friendship, and shelter.
lineage.runic_roots.nymph.backstory: Graceful nature spirits of rivers and springs; charming healers and enchantresses fierce in defense of their waters.
lineage.runic_roots.primian.backstory: The first humans: fortune, charisma, and boundless adaptability incarnate; the world quietly bends toward them.
lineage.runic_roots.reaper.backstory: Grim harbingers touched by death's silence; soul-reaping executioners and solemn guardians of the final passage.
lineage.runic_roots.returned.backstory: People sustained by a purpose left unfinished. The Returned seek the confrontation ahead; they claim no second resurrection or borrowed death-site.
lineage.runic_roots.runic_one.backstory: Dwarves steeped in stone-carved runes; rune-smiths who bind power into steel and stone, keepers of old knowledge.
lineage.runic_roots.saurian.backstory: Watchful scaled survivors who let the world move first. Their patience prepares a close ambush; venom is another bloodline's answer.
lineage.runic_roots.scaleheir.backstory: Grounded heirs to dragonkind, bearing scales and a steady presence. Their lineage needs neither elemental breath nor wings to stand its ground.
lineage.runic_roots.sea_serpen.backstory: Great serpentine drakes of the deep; coiling masters of tide and current whose breath drowns the shore.
lineage.runic_roots.serpen.backstory: Calm, dangerous folk of snake blood; venomous mystics and assassins who strike with the quiet power of the coiled strike.
lineage.runic_roots.skeleton.backstory: Fleshless undead given motion by old oaths; eerie, tireless bonecrafters and unerring archers.
lineage.runic_roots.sky_one.backstory: Proud mountain dwarves of wind-cut citadels above the clouds; sure-footed climbers and sharp-eyed sentries of the heights.
lineage.runic_roots.sprite.backstory: Tiny, lively fae of wild magic and starlight; quick-winged pranksters far more dangerous than they appear.
lineage.runic_roots.terra_drake.backstor: Mountainous drakes of stone and root; their hide is living rock and their breath shatters the earth.
lineage.runic_roots.tide_elf.backstory: Coastal elves at home where sunlight breaks into currents. Their hands work as naturally beneath the water as upon the shore.
lineage.runic_roots.valen.backstory: Valiant, honorable humans of unbending strength — the immovable rock that corners a foe — living in equilibrium with nature.
lineage.runic_roots.volt_drake.backstory: Swift drakes wreathed in storm-light; their breath is the thunderbolt and their wings outrun the gale.
lineage.runic_roots.wailer.backstory: Sorrowful spirits who warn the world before their voices break upon it. Their awareness follows nearby wounded threats, not hidden lives beyond the walls.
lineage.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.backstory: Sinuous sky-wyrms born of the high winds; the freest and most ancient of drakes, riding the jetstreams above the clouds.
lineage.runic_roots.wraith.backstory: Spectral undead shaped by sorrow and vengeance; silent, shadow-bound hunters who drain the soul and haunt forgotten graves.
lineage.runic_roots.wyvernkin.backstory: Lean dragonfolk with hooked wings and a single venomous commitment. They borrow height from the landscape, then spend it on one precise swoop.
lineage.runic_roots.zephyr.backstory: Air spirits gathered into delicate mortal outlines. Their ribbon-like fins catch small currents, preferring precision over a dragon's power.
lineage.runic_roots.zombie.backstory: Undead animated by plague and stubborn refusal to rest; tireless, pain-resistant, and grimly hard to put down.
